summary: Iteration 7 completed for backend+frontend. Backend try-on/save validation suite passed (9/9). Frontend reproduced critical regression after Lookbook visualize: repeated 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors, blank try-on render area, and Share/Save actions not completing on web.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful visualize, page enters repeated React error loop ('Maximum update depth exceeded'), card shows a large blank/white try-on area, and actions become unreliable.
Tapping SHARE/SAVE on a visualized card did not produce download/toast in web run; expect_download timed out and no success feedback appeared.

integration_issues.flow: Lookbook visualize -> include render in share/save export
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by runtime render loop; could not validate exported PNG content (full uncropped render + title/note + AI label + watermark) because share/save did not complete once loop started.
Partially blocked by same runtime loop after Lookbook visualize; could not finish full flow matrix (A and B final assertions) in one stable run.

issues: No horizontal overflow observed in captured viewport.
Try-on display region became blank/white after runtime loop, so visual quality/cropping validation is currently blocked.

react_native_issues.issue: Continuous React error spam in console: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' immediately after visualize success; likely caused by repeated state updates during image-ready signaling path.

action_items: Fix Lookbook runtime update loop after try-on render is set (investigate readyImages/onReady state update churn around lookbook card + TryOnPreview).
Re-test SHARE/SAVE exports after loop fix and verify generated PNG contains render + title/note + AI label + STYLEVAULT watermark and is not blank/loading.
Re-run Stylist flow A/B completion checks after frontend stability fix: no duplication when Save Outfit first then Save Try-On; visualise-first path persists identical image path into Lookbook.
After fix, validate persistence after tab switch and fresh login in a clean run.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend validation logic in /api/outfits and /api/outfits/{id}/visualize works as intended for ownership, unknown/deleted IDs, missing profile photo, unavailable items, and visualization_path matching (verified by pytest).

Probable frontend RCA hotspot: lookbook.tsx updates readyImages via onReady callback for TryOnPreview on every ready signal without guarding no-op updates, which can create render-update churn on web.
Because runtime loop begins after visualize success, Share/Save regression may be secondary fallout rather than isolated action-handler failure.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated backend test users (iter7_basic, iter7_owner, iter7_foreign, iter7_unavailable, iter7_path_main, iter7_path_other with random suffixes) via /api/auth/register. Used existing dedicated UI account lookbook.tryon.qa@example.com / pass1234 and uploaded /app/tests/fixtures/full_body_fixture.jpg through Profile chooser.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the same public URL from frontend/.env. Repro path for critical bug: login -> Lookbook -> visualize saved outfit -> wait for try-on saved; then console starts spamming 'Maximum update depth exceeded', bottom toast appears, and share/save actions stop behaving. No backend mock used.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) Login QA account (lookbook.tryon.qa@example.com/pass1234). (2) Ensure saved outfit exists. (3) Trigger Lookbook Visualise on me and wait for TRY-ON SAVED state. (4) Observe blank try-on frame + repeated console/runtime error 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. (5) SHARE/SAVE no longer complete reliably. Likely root cause is a frontend state feedback loop in Lookbook/TryOnPreview ready-state synchronization; repeated setState during image load/ready causes render loop and blocks downstream interactions.
